author_or_account: National Center for Travel Behavior and Demand
title: ATUS 2025 Data Now Incorporated into TBD Center Dashboards!
discussion_signal: The post turns the 2025 American Time Use Survey into public dashboards for mobility, travel, telework, wellbeing, and population-group comparisons. It shows how a time-use dataset becomes a practical civic and planning instrument rather than remaining only a statistical release.
linked_research_question: How do work, care, leisure, mobility, and digital time compete in everyday life, and how are those patterns made usable for public decisions?
limits: The post describes dashboard capability rather than presenting a full result set
Dashboard users and downstream decisions are not measured
A public data tool does not by itself establish causal effects
